technique_name: Compare and contrast reading a book to watching a movie.
description: Reading a book and watching a movie are different yet complementary experiences. Reading a book provides an individual with the opportunity to exercise their imagination, create their own mental pictures of the characters, and analyze the plot and themes in more detail. Books allow readers to explore the emotions of the characters in greater depth, and are more conducive to thoughtful contemplation.
